verdict.rationale: Cooley documents its own offices across multiple countries (US cities, Beijing, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Singapore, London, Brussels) plus stated international practices, and its UK/France-specific documents and practice pages confirm substantive multi-jurisdiction capability (e.g., UK NDA forms, France S-1 drafting service, UK/Singapore SAFE variants, international patent/trademark teams spanning US/UK/Europe). Missing for 10: independent corroboration of actual cross-border client engagements and clearer articulation of how office network specifically avoids 'second firm' referrals for founders expanding abroad.
